ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) with less than 5% high-intensity (white/light) pixels, primarily localized at the distal tips and as transient specular highlights.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous uniform dark pigmentation across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast, textured clusters (white/brown) are mapped at the far lateral distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 50-degree interior angle dividing the lobes symmetrically.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations observed along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased prominence and irregularity near the lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the median notch extending to the lateral tips, exhibiting an upward sweep relative to the water line.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized, high-contrast, roughly circular textured clusters present on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonization at the extreme lateral margins of both lobes, appearing as high-contrast, textured protrusions.
other_distinctive_markers: Uniform distribution of high-intensity pixel points (water droplets) across the ventral surface, creating a stippled contrast effect.
